title: Full-text search in PostgreSQL
brief: Build PostgreSQL text retrieval from linguistic matching through ranked, filtered results.
outcomes: Derive token, phrase and ranking behaviour from a configuration
Keep index retrieval and relevance evaluation distinct
entry: PostgreSQL operators/index methods and query result semantics.

heading.title: From catalogue text to lexemes
heading.brief: Use proposed product descriptions to follow configuration, tokenisation, dictionaries and positions; compare query constructors and safe user-input handling.

heading.title: Words and phrases
heading.brief: Show exact expected matches for the same small corpus under terms, phrases, stop words and language choice; avoid equating lexeme matching with arbitrary substring search.

heading.title: Ranking within a filter
heading.brief: Weight title and description fields, apply shop/category filters and tie breakers, and evaluate relevance using declared example judgements.

heading.title: GIN and ongoing changes
heading.brief: Inspect indexed candidate retrieval and rechecks; maintain document vectors and configuration changes consistently, measuring latency separately from relevance.
